So obligation could be: "Establish the title of the research paper that was written between 2012 and 2022 by two authors, one of whom was academic staff at Harran University as of 2023 and has another research paper in the Journal of Baltic Science Education published between 2016 and 2023, and that contains six tables, one of which reports an emotion at 13.53 percent."

C1 says Yaşar at Harran. Need establish if he has JBSE paper. But the name of the paper is the target. The obligation could be the paper title.

If we ask "What is the name of the research paper satisfying all clues?" that's the original question, not local. But allowed? It says one local coherent research objective. Thus:

"Identify the research paper that was published between 2012 and 2022, has two authors, includes six tables with one table reporting an emotion at 13.53 percent, and is connected to an author who, as of 2023, was academic staff at Harran University and has another research paper in the Journal of Baltic Science Education published between 2016 and 2023."

This preserves relation scope: paper published 2012-2022, two authors, one author relation to Harran and JBSE. It asks to identify paper. It doesn't jump to downstream. It includes all clues. Is that one coherent objective? Yes, identify paper satisfying conditions. It may be slightly broad but okay.

Maybe we can phrase more naturally: "Establish the title of the research paper written between 2012 and 2022 by two authors, one of whom was academic staff at Harran University as of 2023 and has another research paper in the Journal of Baltic Science Education published between 2016 and 2023, and which contains six tables, including one table where an emotion is reported at 13.53 percent."
